claim_text: Коэффициент диффузии азота зависит от температуры по закону Аррениуса

caveats.text: Trapping effects in alloyed steels (Fe-V-N) can reduce effective diffusion coefficient at lower temperatures, making apparent Arrhenius slope steeper than intrinsic one.
At high nitrogen concentrations, diffusion coefficient becomes concentration-dependent, deviating from simple Arrhenius behavior.
